sections.heading: Hey, I'm Jared.
sections.label: Founder & Builder
sections.text: I run Bestly out of Los Angeles. We build private cloud servers for businesses (In-House Cloud), privacy-first apps and browser extensions, and a few physical products. Everything ships with the same default: collect less, ask first, never sell.Los Angeles, California

sections.heading: Why I Started This
sections.text: I got tired of building things that worked against the people using them — products designed to extract data, exploit attention, and maximize engagement at all costs.So I started building the opposite. Technology that makes life better without making privacy worse. That's not a tagline — it's how I decide what to build and what to skip.

sections.heading: Lean by Design
sections.text: Bestly is founder-led and intentionally lean. No outside investors pushing us to monetize your data. No board meetings debating whether to sell your information.This structure lets us move fast and stay principled — from software to physical products, the same standards apply to everything we ship.

sections.heading: Why Cookie Yeti?

sections.text: The big one

sections.heading: It actually says no
sections.label: The big one
sections.text: Most cookie blockers just hide the pop-up — some even click 'Accept all' to make it vanish, which is the opposite of privacy. Cookie Yeti clicks 'Reject' for real, so websites can't follow you around.

sections.heading: It keeps getting better
sections.text: Cookie blockers can stop working when websites change their pop-ups. Cookie Yeti keeps adding fixes. When a pop-up is tricky, our AI works out how to close it, and the fix is shared with everyone using Cookie Yeti. Nothing for you to update.

sections.heading: It won't break your sites
sections.text: Broken pages are the number-one gripe about every cookie blocker — dead scrollbars, endless login loops. Cookie Yeti has a built-in safety brake: if a site starts acting up, it backs off before anything breaks. Your favorite sites keep working like normal.

sections.text: Electrolysis processWater + Salt + Electricity = Hypochlorous Acid (HOCl)

sections.heading: Naturally Gentle
sections.text: Hypochlorous acid is the same thing your white blood cells make to keep you clean.

sections.heading: Three Simple Ingredients
sections.text: Water, salt, and electricity. No alcohol, no fragrance, no oils, no preservatives.

sections.heading: Sealed Can, No Pump
sections.text: The liquid sits in a sealed bag inside the can, so air never reaches it. The last spray is the same as the first.

sections.heading: Gentle on Sensitive Skin
sections.text: No alcohol, no fragrance, no oils. Nothing that stings.Why it comes in a can:Hypochlorous acid breaks down when it meets air, and a pump bottle pulls air in every time you press it. HOKU's can never lets air back in, so spray two hundred works like spray one.

sections.heading: The Science of HOCl
sections.text: Hypochlorous acid is produced by your own white blood cells. HOKU makes it by running an electric current through salt water. It is manufactured as a cosmetic under FDA regulations for Bestly LLC.Learn More About the Science

sections.text: Mist HOKU onto clean skin from six to eight inches away, morning and night. No rinsing. Layer anything you like on top, or nothing at all.
